adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for handleCancelBooking.ts around line 423, the code now iterates over `bookingCalendarReference` (an array of calendar references). Inside the loop, when handling recurring events (lines 430-450), it still iterates over ALL `bookingToDelete.user.credentials` and for EACH credential iterates over ALL `updatedBookings`, finding only the FIRST calendar reference (`find` instead of `filter`). This means: 1) The outer loop runs once per calendar reference, 2) The inner recurring logic runs for ALL credentials regardless of which reference we're processing, 3) It only finds the first `_calendar` reference per booking. This creates duplicate delete attempts when there are multiple calendar references, and doesn't properly handle multiple calendar references per booking in the recurring case.
